model.algorithm: xgb+lgb+cb ensemble (weighted mean of probs) + RobustScaler + PlattCalibration
model.explanation_method: native TreeSHAP (XGBoost pred_contribs / LightGBM pred_contrib / CatBoost ShapValues)

explanation_validation.method: native TreeSHAP (XGBoost pred_contribs / LightGBM pred_contrib / CatBoost ShapValues) — same algorithm as shap.TreeExplainer, run inside each booster; ensemble attribution = weighted average of per-model SHAP vectors (documented approximation: contributions are in logit space, ensemble raw = weighted mean of probabilities)

pipeline_replication.detail: hand-replicated map+scale+predict+calibrate pipeline reproduces the engine's final score to <1e-6 on every transaction; the explanation SHAP vectors are computed from the identical scaled matrix X that produces those scores, so explanations use the exact feature values supplied to the model

no_future_information.detail: all 15 features derive from the incoming pre-transaction ML_FEATURES dict + historical entity fraud rates (tracker lookups); the mapper is stateless, uses only the current event's inputs; provenance table below

feature_provenance.chip: new_device_flag proxy for online/chip — event only
feature_provenance.mcc_n: HARDCODED 0 in runtime mapper (parity PARTIAL, check #16)
feature_provenance.has_zip: HARDCODED 0 in runtime mapper (parity PARTIAL, check #16)
feature_provenance.has_state: HARDCODED 0 in runtime mapper (parity PARTIAL, check #16)
feature_provenance.merch_tx_count: historical merchant tx count (tracker/input) — before event
feature_provenance.merch_fraud_rate: historical merchant fraud rate — before event (tracker or input)
feature_provenance.city_fraud_rate: historical city fraud rate — before event (tracker or input)

reproducibility.determinism_note: XGB/LGB/CB tree models are deterministic for fixed inputs; no nondeterminism documented in the deployed path (no GPU, no sampling at predict time).

deployed_decision_path_finding.finding: The loaded calibrator (models/artifacts/calibrator.joblib, PlattCalibration) was fit by src/train_compare.py on the PS-14 SYNTHETIC model family's out-of-archetype scores, not on the deployed lean Altman model. The lean model's raw ensemble scores saturate (p50=0.9619 on this batch), and the Platt sigmoid compresses the entire output range into [0.0274, 0.2540].
deployed_decision_path_finding.impact: production band_of() flags ml_score*100 >= 85 as verify; the deployed calibrated score never reaches 0.85 on this batch, so the ML path is inert in the decision layer regardless of the raw model's signal
deployed_decision_path_finding.cross_reference: consistent with check #16 PRODUCTION PARITY = FAIL (artifact set never validated end-to-end)
deployed_decision_path_finding.recommendation: fit a calibrator on the deployed model's own OOF scores, or remove calibration and lock a threshold on raw scores
